result.stdout:
Generates Semiodesk.Trinity vocabulary classes from RDF files.

  trinity-vocab <manifest.json> [--check]

  --check   Do not write anything; exit non-zero if the generated files on
            disk no longer match the vocabularies. Intended for CI.

Manifest format:

  {
    "namespace": "My.Project",
    "output": "Ontologies",   // directory, optional
    "vocabularies": [
      { "file": "ontologies/foaf.rdf", "prefix": "foaf",
        "uri": "http://xmlns.com/foaf/0.1/" }
    ]
  }

Each vocabulary is written to its own <prefix>.g.cs in the output directory.
Paths are relative to the manifest. A manifest may also be an array of such
objects, to generate into several namespaces in one run.
